findings.text: Provides blocking semaphore acquisition that waits in killable state with unbounded patience when no unit is free, otherwise takes a unit immediately while holding the internal guard.
Provides nonblocking semaphore attempt that never waits; it reports success when a unit was available and failure otherwise, leaving contention handling to the caller.
Provides bounded semaphore acquisition that waits uninterruptibly up to a caller supplied duration when no unit is free, otherwise takes a unit immediately.
Provides semaphore release that either returns a unit to the free tally when nobody waits, or transfers ownership to the head waiter and schedules its wakeup after releasing the internal guard.
Waiter node holds queue linkage plus a pointer to the waiting execution context plus a boolean completion marker that the releaser sets before requesting wakeup.
Semaphore tally and waiter queue mutations are serialized by the object internal raw guard taken with interrupts preserved, with actual wakeups deferred until after that guard is released.

Semaphore progresses from immediate grant while tally positive, to queued wait under the mode implied by the entry used, to handoff where release dequeues the head waiter and marks it ready instead of incrementing the tally.
Exposes raw exclusive guard operations for try, blocking lock, and unlock in plain plus interrupt saving, interrupt masking, bottom half masked, and interrupt restoration flavors.

Exposes raw reader writer operations for read and write try, blocking lock, and unlock in plain plus interrupt saving, interrupt masking, and bottom half masked flavors, including a nested write form.

Generic blocking acquisition template suppresses preemption and, for interrupt aware forms, interrupts while polling the underlying try operation, relaxing the processor between attempts until success; the bottom half form layers bottom half masking over the interrupt saving form.
Dedicated interrupt disabling acquisition loops with preemption and interrupts suppressed while polling the underlying try operation and relaxing between attempts until success.
Architecture relaxation hooks for read, write, and exclusive polling default to a processor relax hint when no platform override exists.
A per processor instance of write barrier tracking state exists for use around raw acquisition paths.
Debug initializers place the architecture primitive in unlocked state, install a type specific magic tag, and reset ownership tracking to an init sentinel and a negative processor number.

Successful debug exclusive acquisition records the current processor and execution context as owner; debug release validates type tag, locked state, and owner identity before clearing ownership back to sentinel values.

Debug exclusive paths treat corrupt tag, reentry by the same context, reentry on the same processor, release of an unlocked object, and release by a foreign context or processor as fatal diagnostic events with a dump.
On non symmetric builds a failed underlying exclusive or reader writer try operation is treated as a bug rather than ordinary contention.

Debug read paths only validate the type tag around the architecture primitive without ownership tracking, while debug write paths enforce non recursion and maintain ownership across lock, successful try, and unlock.

Realtime exclusive guards are sleeping locks built over a base mutex with a fast atomic handoff and slower fallback, permitting rescheduling before acquisition and then entering read side critical section plus migration suppression on success.
Realtime exclusive acquisition offers subclass and nest aware forms that record dependency information before entering the same sleeping acquisition sequence.

Realtime nonblocking exclusive attempt uses the fast handoff with a slow try fallback and only enters dependency plus read side plus migration guards when it wins; the bottom half form masks bottom halves around the attempt and restores on failure.

Realtime exclusive release drops dependency tracking, reenables migration, releases the base mutex through fast then slow paths, and exits the read side critical section last so the containing object cannot be freed mid release.

Realtime reader writer guards delegate to a reader writer base primitive with a realtime wait state, wrapped with matching dependency acquisition and release plus the same read side and migration guards and last exit rule.

Realtime initializers check that the footprint holds no live dependency state then establish dependency maps with caller supplied identity, marking per processor versus normal flavor for exclusive guards.
Membership test reports whether an address lies inside the linker delimited lock function section; a separate helper asserts soft interrupt context for dependency checking.

Raw exclusive nested forms record dependency subclass or nest relationship while preemption is suppressed, with the interrupt saving form also preserving interrupt state, before contending through try then blocking helpers.

Test support holds a global workqueue pointer and a conditional context initializer that in one configuration arms a very large deadlock injection countdown and in the other simply forwards to the base initializer.
Semaphore entries that may queue require a sleepable context, whereas raw exclusive polling paths never sleep and only suppress preemption or interrupts while spinning.
Release to a nonempty waiter set removes the head waiter, marks its completion indicator, and enqueues its context for wakeup after the guard is dropped instead of adjusting the free tally.
A combined realtime operation acquires then immediately releases an exclusive guard, providing a lock break point.
